user.title: Set up HTBW
user.description:
This creates your household's HTBW configuration. Rooms are added afterward, beneath it.

Retain Enrollment Recordings decides whether the ten voice recordings captured when someone sets up Voice Identity are kept after their Voiceprint is created. Keeping them may let a future Voice Identity update rebuild a Voiceprint automatically; it is never a guarantee. Deleting them means a future incompatible update would require that person to enroll again. This setting never deletes a working Voiceprint, and you can change it later.

data_description.retain_enrollment_recordings: Whether the ten enrollment recordings are kept after a Voiceprint is created. This applies only when the HTBW Voice Evidence App is installed.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the HTBW Voice Evidence App
hassio_confirm.description:
The HTBW Voice Evidence App was found. Connecting it creates your household's HTBW configuration and links the App to it.

Retain Enrollment Recordings decides whether the ten voice recordings captured when someone sets up Voice Identity are kept after their Voiceprint is created. Keeping them may let a future Voice Identity update rebuild a Voiceprint automatically; it is never a guarantee. Deleting them means a future incompatible update would require that person to enroll again. This setting never deletes a working Voiceprint, and you can change it later.

data_description.retain_enrollment_recordings: Whether the ten enrollment recordings are kept after a Voiceprint is created.

abort.already_configured: HTBW is already set up for this household. Add Rooms beneath the existing HTBW entry.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The HTBW Voice Evidence App sent incomplete connection details. Restart the App to provision it again.

init.title: Household settings
init.description:
Retain Enrollment Recordings controls only the ten source recordings captured during Voice Identity enrollment. Changing from Retain to Delete removes recordings already kept; every working Voiceprint is kept and no one needs to enroll again.

External Storage Path is optional. Set it only after you have connected a Share-usage external storage location to Home Assistant under Settings > System > Storage (or its current equivalent). HTBW manages its own folder beneath that path; it never asks for NAS credentials, and nothing is created there until a capability that needs it is enabled. Your selection is always saved -- if Home Assistant needs one more security step before HTBW can use it, you'll see clear instructions under Settings > System > Repairs.

data_description.retain_enrollment_recordings: Retain keeps the enrollment recordings for a possible future automatic rebuild. Delete removes them; working Voiceprints are never deleted.
data_description.external_storage_path: Pick your Home Assistant-managed Share-usage external storage from the list, or type a path, for example /share/htbw-storage. Leave blank if you have not connected external storage yet. Your choice is kept even if Home Assistant needs one more one-time security step before HTBW can use it.

error.media_path_not_supported: This path is a Home Assistant Media-usage folder. HTBW uses Share-usage external storage only, never Media, so your existing Media content stays separate. Use the path to your Share-usage connection instead (Settings > System > Storage).

user.title: Add an HTBW room
user.description: Configure how this room participates in HTBW. Choose the room and, if applicable, its voice input and spoken response output. You can add an interface or physical remote afterward by reconfiguring the room.

data_description.area_id: The Home Assistant area this HTBW Room represents. Each area can be added once.
data_description.voice_input: Entities that hear spoken requests in this room, such as an Assist satellite. Optional.
data_description.spoken_response_output: Media players that speak responses in this room. Optional.

reconfigure.title: Room interaction functions
reconfigure.description: Select the native Home Assistant entities or devices assigned to each interaction function for this room. Multiple selections are independent assignments, not a priority or fallback order. Clear a field to remove its participating assignments.

interface.name: Interface
interface.description: Select devices that provide this room's visual or manual interface.

error.area_not_found: The selected room could not be found.
error.unsupported_reference_type: A stored assignment uses a native reference type this form cannot edit. No assignments have been changed. Report this configuration limitation to the integration maintainer.

options.retain: Retain — keep the ten recordings for possible future automatic rebuild
options.delete: Delete — remove the ten recordings after the Voiceprint is created

invalid_room_data.message: HTBW could not start because its stored Room configuration is invalid. Nothing was changed or deleted. Restore a Home Assistant backup taken before this happened, or report the problem on the HTBW issue tracker.

missing_reference.title: A configured HTBW reference no longer exists
missing_reference.description: The {function} assignment for "{entry_title}" refers to {reference_id}, which no longer exists in Home Assistant. HTBW will not search for a replacement. Open this room's configuration under the HTBW integration and choose a new reference, or remove the assignment.

room_migration_conflict.title: An HTBW room could not be moved into the household configuration
room_migration_conflict.description: The earlier HTBW room entry "{entry_title}" could not be moved under the household HTBW entry because a room with the same Area already exists there with different settings. Nothing was deleted: the earlier entry is kept so its settings can be recovered. Compare the two, keep the correct room configuration, and remove the other entry.

voice_evidence_unreachable.title: Voice evidence is unavailable: the HTBW Voice Evidence App cannot be reached
voice_evidence_unreachable.description: HTBW cannot reach the HTBW Voice Evidence App ({reason_code}). Voice identification is unavailable; everything else in HTBW, including your rooms, keeps working. Check that the App is installed and running under Settings > Apps.

voice_evidence_authentication_failed.title: Voice evidence is unavailable: the App rejected HTBW's credential
voice_evidence_authentication_failed.description: The HTBW Voice Evidence App rejected HTBW's stored credential, which happens after the App's secret is rotated or its data is reset. Restart the App so it provisions HTBW again. Voice identification stays unavailable until then; nothing else is affected.

voice_evidence_incompatible.title: Voice evidence is unavailable: the App version is incompatible
voice_evidence_incompatible.description: The installed HTBW Voice Evidence App is not compatible with this version of HTBW ({reason_code}). Update the App and HTBW to matching versions. Voice identification stays unavailable until then; nothing else is affected.

voice_evidence_app_unavailable.title: Voice evidence is unavailable: the App is not ready
voice_evidence_app_unavailable.description: The HTBW Voice Evidence App is running but reports that it cannot work yet ({reason_code}), for example because its voice model is missing or failed verification. Open the App's log under Settings > Apps for details. Voice identification stays unavailable until then; nothing else is affected.

voice_evidence_retention_sync_failed.title: The Retain Enrollment Recordings setting has not reached the Voice Evidence App
voice_evidence_retention_sync_failed.description: HTBW could not apply your Retain Enrollment Recordings setting to the HTBW Voice Evidence App. HTBW keeps retrying. If this persists, check that the App is installed and running under Settings > Apps.

external_storage_path_not_allowed.title: One more step: allow HTBW to use your selected storage
external_storage_path_not_allowed.description:
You selected {path} for HTBW's External Storage. Nothing is wrong: for security, Home Assistant requires a one-time permission before any integration -- including HTBW -- can use a storage location you select. Your selection is saved; you will not need to choose it again.

To finish:
1. Open the File editor app (Settings > Apps > File editor; install it first if you don't have it) and open configuration.yaml.
2. Add {path} to the allowlist_external_dirs list, inside a homeassistant: section (select "Learn more" below for exact examples covering every situation).
3. Before restarting, check your configuration for mistakes: Settings > Tools > YAML > Check configuration.
4. Restart Home Assistant: Settings > System > the power icon > Restart Home Assistant.

HTBW recognizes your storage automatically after the restart -- nothing else to configure.

external_storage_media_path_not_supporte.title: External Storage is unavailable: this path is Media-usage, not Share-usage
external_storage_media_path_not_supporte.description: The configured External Storage path is a Home Assistant Media-usage folder ({reason_code}). HTBW uses Share-usage external storage only, so your existing Media content stays separate. Open the HTBW options and set the path to your Share-usage connection instead. Capabilities that need External Storage stay unavailable until then; nothing else is affected.

external_storage_unavailable.title: External Storage is unavailable
external_storage_unavailable.description: HTBW cannot reach the configured External Storage path ({reason_code}). Check that the storage is connected and powered on under Settings > System > Storage. Capabilities that need External Storage stay unavailable until then; nothing else is affected.

external_storage_read_only.title: External Storage is read-only
external_storage_read_only.description: The configured External Storage path exists but HTBW cannot write to it ({reason_code}). Check the storage's permissions. Capabilities that need External Storage stay unavailable until then; nothing else is affected.

external_storage_write_failed.title: External Storage write failed
external_storage_write_failed.description: A write to the configured External Storage path failed ({reason_code}), for example because the storage is full. Capabilities that need External Storage stay unavailable until this is resolved; nothing else is affected.

external_storage_invalid_root.title: External Storage's HTBW folder could not be verified
external_storage_invalid_root.description: HTBW's own folder on the configured External Storage path exists but could not be verified ({reason_code}). This can happen after restoring an old backup onto newer storage. Capabilities that need External Storage stay unavailable until this is resolved; nothing else is affected.
